Not verified on a device yet. This is the one control in the root track that has not been through a reboot test, so treat it as unproven and check the charge state yourself after the first reboot.

This is the only part of the app that keeps running in the background. While it is on you will see a permanent notification, and it stops itself as soon as it has nothing left to do.\n\nAfter a reboot, with the switch above on the limit carries on. With it off the limit is switched off, and the app starts once only to reopen the charge gate if the reboot left charging held, then stops.
Turn the ROM battery protection to Charge fully while using this, or the two will fight over the same hardware.
The resume level is always kept at least ⁦%1$d⁩ percent below the stop level, so charging cannot switch on and off repeatedly.
